item.title: Armed Bandits Attack Zamfara Village, Kills One, Abducts Five Others
item.description: Armed bandits stormed Fananawa village in Bukuyum Local Government Area of Zamfara State on Saturday night, resulting in the death of one resident, the abduction of five others, and serious injuries to another.According to local accounts, the attackers operated from evening until dawn, instilling fear in the community. item.title: Governor Makinde Set to Sign N892 Billion 2026 Budget into Law on Monday
item.description: Oyo State Governor, Engineer Seyi Makinde, is scheduled to sign the 2026 Appropriation Bill, valued at approximately N892 billion, into law on Monday, December 22, 2025.The signing ceremony will take place at 10:30 a.m. in the Executive Council Chambers of the Governor’s Office in Ibadan. item.title: Alaafin of Oyo Confers Prestigious Chieftaincy Titles on Senator Abdul'aziz Yari, Seyi Tinubu
item.description: His Imperial Majesty, Oba Abimbola Akeem Owoade I, the Alaafin of Oyo, on Saturday installed former Zamfara State Governor and Senator representing Zamfara West, Abdul'aziz Yari, with the esteemed chieftaincy title of Obaloyin of Yorubaland.During the same colourful ceremony held at the Alaafin's Palace in Oyo town, Seyi Tinubu, son of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, was installed as the Okanlomo of Yorubaland.The title "Okanlomo of Yorubaland" signifies "the one dear to the hearts of all Yoruba pe

item.title: Troops Uncover Bomb Planted on Borno road, Arrest Suspected Terrorist Logistics Suppliers

item.title: Fubara Pays Condolence Visit to Diri Over Deputy Governor's Death
item.description: Rivers State Governor, Sir Siminalayi Fubara, on Sunday paid a condolence visit to his Bayelsa State counterpart, Senator Douye Diri, following the sudden death of Bayelsa's Deputy Governor, Senator Lawrence Ewhrudjakpo.The visit took place at the Government House in Yenagoa, where Governor Fubara personally commiserated with Governor Diri over the loss.Senator Ewhrudjakpo, aged 60, passed away suddenly on December 11, 2025, after collapsing in his office. item.title: All Remaining Abducted Students from Niger Catholic School Freed

item.title: CBN Debunks Viral Social Media Rumours of Fire at Abuja Headquarters

item.title: Nigerian, five others indicted in $41m US stock market fraud
